subject: Sentry Health — on‑prem 'Sentry Fence' add-on and renewal term uplift
messages:
From: Emma Jensen <emma.jensen@sentryhealth.com>

Cc: Liam O'Rourke <liam.orourke@sentryhealth.com>, procurement@sentryhealth.com
Date: Sat, 1 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sentry Fence on‑prem add + renewal — initial ask

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the renewal packet — we reviewed and have one strategic ask before we sign: we want to add an on‑prem privacy perimeter for our PHI processing pipelines (we're calling it "Sentry Fence"). The requirements are straightforward:

- A dedicated isolated environment (VPC + on‑prem gateway) for the ingestion and prescreening pipelines
- Two additional GPU clusters for inference-only traffic (production + warm standby)
- Audit logs forwarded to our SIEM for 90 days retention

We understand this is beyond the base renewal and will impact term/pricing. Target timeline: production by Nov 1, can you outline lead times and the incremental pricing? Also, we will route procurement questions to procurement@sentryhealth.com but wanted to surface technical feasibility first.

Liam (CTO) is copied — he can join a short technical call if needed.

Thanks,
Emma
Emma Jensen
Head of Platform Engineering | Sentry Health

Soojin — quick pricing sketch based on what they asked for. Numbers are rough until we lock the SOW and topology.

Option A — 12 month renewal + 2 on‑prem clusters (prod + standby) + isolation stack
- One‑time provisioning & on‑site engineering: $82,000
- Monthly runrate uplift (capacity + isolated network): $28,500/mo
- Estimated additional token/throughput charges: depends on burst patterns; assume $3,500/mo baseline
- Total 12‑month incremental: ~$512k

Option B — 24 month renewal (preferred discount)
- One‑time provisioning & on‑site engineering: $82,000 (same)
- Monthly runrate uplift: $24,000/mo (reduced rate)
- Total 24‑month incremental (first 12 months effective): ~$500k but with lower unit economics over 24 months — net present lower OPEX

Security/Compliance notes: we should include a KMS integration line, SIEM webhook SLA (log delivery contract), and an SLA exception window for on‑prem maintenance.

I'll attach a pricing comparison spreadsheet. If leadership wants to subsidize the one‑time engineering cost we can accelerate a Nov 1 target.

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Head of Renewals & Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference

> Option A — 12 month renewal + 2 on‑prem clusters (prod + standby) + isolation stack
> - One‑time provisioning & on‑site engineering: $82,000
> - Monthly runrate uplift (capacity + isolated network): $28,500/mo

Works for me as an initial plan. Ops notes and timeline:
- Pre‑reqs from Sentry: rack space & power profile, network ACLs, IP ranges, on‑site contact for install window
- Standard provision lead time: 7–9 weeks from signed SOW given hardware lead times; OS/hypervisor image and connectivity workstreams run in parallel
- Canary plan: 2 week isolated soak in our staging followed by 48h controlled traffic ramp to prod; expect 3 business days for final cutover with rollback window
- Post‑install runbooks: we'll hand off a Runbook + Playbook (runbooks include KV cache warmup, prefix cache migration, and failover triggers)

If we sign by Aug 16 we can realistically meet Nov 1 with a hard engineering push and vendor expedited shipping. Any earlier procurement blockers push the schedule.

—Priyom

Principal Systems Engineer, Redwood Inference

Emma / Liam — thanks for the quick context and for looping procurement. Based on our internal alignment below, here's a consolidated path we recommend: 

1) Commercial path (choose term):
   - 24 month renewal (recommended) — lower monthly rate and predictable operations; we can offer a 6% concession on the one‑time engineering fee if signed by Aug 16.
   - 12 month renewal — higher monthly but greater yearly flexibility; we'll provide a pilot pricing tier for month 1.

2) Technical scope we will deliver:
   - Dedicated isolated VPC + on‑prem gateway appliance
   - Two inference clusters (prod + warm standby), N=2 GPU nodes each (config: A100 equiv.)
   - KV/prefix cache migration and audit log forwarding to your SIEM for 90 days
   - KMS integration (customer key) and HSM support line item

3) Timeline & milestones (target Nov 1):
   - Sign SOW by Aug 16 -> procurement/PO -> order hardware (2–3 weeks) -> install window (7–9 weeks) -> 2 week staging soak -> final cutover

4) Next steps:
   - I'll attach a revised SOW (SOW_SentryFence_v2.pdf) and a pricing comparison.
   - If procurement is ready, send PO to procurement@sentryhealth.com and I'll initiate DocuSign for the SOW and DPA.

Attachments: SOW_SentryFence_v2.pdf, privacy-fence-arch.png, pricing-comparison-12v24.xlsx

Would you be available for a 30 minute alignment call this Thursday (Aug 5) 10–10:30am PT?

Best,
Soojin Lee
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
